name: arogax2-monorepo
description: A multi-service MERN setup for patient, clinic, laboratory, and hospital modules

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend/auth && npm install --prefix backend/patient && npm install --prefix backend/clinic && npm install --prefix backend/laboratory && npm install --prefix backend/hospital && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,patient,clinic,laboratory,hospital,frontend -c gray,blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend/auth run dev" "npm --prefix backend/patient run dev" "npm --prefix backend/clinic run dev" "npm --prefix backend/laboratory run dev" "npm --prefix backend/hospital run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
